text: OVERDOSAGE Excessive topical use of TAZORAC ® Creams 0.05% and 0.1% may lead to marked redness, peeling, or discomfort (see PRECAUTIONS: General ). TAZORAC ® Creams 0.05% and 0.1% are not for oral use. Oral ingestion of the drug may lead to the same adverse effects as those associated with excessive oral intake of Vitamin A (hypervitaminosis A) or other retinoids. If oral ingestion occurs, the patient should be monitored, and appropriate supportive measures should be administered as necessary.
